source.description_nl: Jaargemiddelde depositie totaal stikstof in Nederland (droog + nat)
source.unit: mol N per ha per year
source.report: Mijnen-Visser et al., Grootschalige concentratie- en depositiekaarten Nederland, Rapportage juni 2026
source.licence: See RIVM disclaimer and copyright page (not checked yet)

notes: Values are shown as published by RIVM. No own deposition modelling.
The uncertainty per grid cell is large; differences between neighbouring cells are often not meaningful.
The metadata in this file is the metadata RIVM gives for the total-nitrogen map.
For deposition on nature areas RIVM refers to its report 'Monitor stikstofdepositie in Natura 2000-gebieden'.
Grid cells cover Nijkerk plus about 15 km around it.
share_in_municipality is the fraction of the cell that lies inside the municipal boundary.
